description: Personalized reasoning effort level mapping for the user's specific Claude Code models based on their settings.json

nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.notes: Nemotron 3 Ultra supports reasoning budget control via max_thinking_tokens parameter. Values represent thinking budget in tokens.

nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b.notes: Nemotron 3 Super supports reasoning budget control via max_thinking_tokens parameter. Values represent thinking budget in tokens.

step-3.5-flash.notes: Step 3.5 Flash is a reasoning model likely supporting thinking budget control. Values represent thinking budget in tokens.

global_defaults.description: Fallback mappings used when no model-specific mapping is found
global_defaults.notes: Default behavior maps all levels to 'high' except low/medium which stay as-is. This is a conservative approach to avoid excessive token usage.

usage_examples.notes: Example showing how to set NIM_REASONING_EFFORT_MAPPINGS for just low and high levels
